en: Captain, Coro's\nyou-know-where again.
Don't tell me the battle\nsimulator is broken again!?
No, I do not believe there\nis anything wrong with it.
Hm!?
Wha―!? What's with the\nfire―!?
Wait, where are we?
This is Fun City on the\nartificial planet Energy\nNede!
The entire city is one big\ntheme―
Yeah, yeah, we heard you\nthe last time!
But still, I can't believe\nwhat I'm seeing.
What? You smell\nsomething? Well, I do smell\nsomething burning, but...
Oh, this is terrible! There\nis a huge fire over at the\narena!
Let's go see if we can\nhelp. Come on, hurry!
Rawwwrrr! I'll burn ya to a\ncrisp!
Ack, Michael! What're you\ndoing here?
Shut your trap! I came to\nplay with you, ya bunch o'\nsluggards!
Ack!
Claude!!!
Don't worry about me,\nRena! How're the folks at\nFun City!?

The evacuation is
complete. I asked Bowman
and the others to prepare
a damage report.

Tsk. I'd planned on turning
everyone and everything
into a smoldering ash
heap.
But whatever. At least I'll\nget to turn you guys into\ncrispy critters.
Huh!?
Are you okay? We're here\nto help.
Who are you people?
We were just passing by.\nThis is the captain, and\nwe are the jolly crew!
Just passing by? Jolly\ncrew?
Yes, of course, this is not\nthe moment for such\nthings!

Heh, heh, numbers alone
aren't gonna save ya! I'll
turn ya all into crispy
critters!
Youch... That's hot... I'm\ntalkin', red hot!
Thanks a lot. You saved\nour hides.

It looks like those who
were injured sustained no
more than minor burns! It
would've been so much
worse without you.
We're lucky you were here,\ntoo.
So, how did you people\nend up here?

Good question! After all,
there are normally only
Nedians here on Energy
Nede.
*Sigh* The answer to that\nis rather long and\ncomplicated. You see...
...And that's about it.

But it doesn't even come
close to describing the
horrors we've been
through!
Ooh, forgive me...

It's weird how the battle
simulator sometimes
sends you to a totally
unexpected point in
space-time.
This may have been an\nunfortunate event for you.

For us, however, fortune
must've been smiling upon
us. We were able to
defeat Michael thanks to
you.

Oh, sorry... I shouldn't have
said that. I mean, I've no
idea what you've been
through.
I think I understand now!
Yes, that must be it!

Our space-time
coordinates converged on
this point so that we
could resolve the situation
here. Yes, that must be it!
It was not chance... It was\ndestiny. The guiding hand\nof fate led us here!
Hey. Stop making excuses!
Hmm... (Still, it does seem\nlike fate brought us\ntogether.)
Er, nothing. Never mind!\nLet's try to get back to\nwhere we started from.
I am a hundred percent\nsure we will end up where\nwe intend to go this time.
How can I trust anything\nyou say?
If this was fate like Coro\nsaid, then I bet we'll meet\nagain!

Yeah, I'll be looking
forward to fighting
side-by-side with you
again―captain to captain.
Mm hmm!
I'll be looking forward to it,\ntoo!
All right, here we go!
It appears we have\nproperly returned this\ntime. Whew, what a relief.

Wait... Didn't you just say
you were a hundred
percent sure this time?
Did we just get lucky?
Oh, umm...

Oh, yes! My work must
have piled up while we
were at Fun City! I must
return to the bridge at
once!

Yes, we were just as lucky
running into Claude and
Rena as they were running
into us.
And we have Coro to\nthank for that. Of course,\ndon't tell him I said that.
Ah!!!
Oh, Eve, when will you\nlearn to be honest with\nyour feelings!?
Hey, weren't you going\nback to the bridge!?

I was just on my way. Well,
then. Captain, Eve...let us
continue boldly forging
ahead!
